FAQ¶

Why does pip install use the package name isotomics?¶

pip installs the distribution name declared in pyproject.toml.

Where are example input files?¶

Bundled example files are in isotomics/input_data/ inside the installed package.

Where do outputs go?¶

Outputs are written to your current working directory unless you provide explicit output paths.
